extensions.name: Orpheon Eclipse Bridge
extensions.author: Orpheon
extensions.description: One ordered list of Eclipse music addons for MySpoti. Plays and downloads through your own addons with exact Spotify URI and ISRC resolution, per-addon settings, health tests and instant fallback.

actions.name: audio.source
actions.why: Play lossless audio through your enabled Eclipse addons

actions.name: download.source
actions.why: Download the same audio from your enabled Eclipse addons

actions.name: playback.events
actions.why: Read the upcoming queue and warm the next songs so they start instantly

actions.name: network
actions.why: Reach the addon manifests, resolve routes and audio streams you configure

actions.name: webview.page
actions.why: Add, test, reorder, enable and configure addons on one page

actions.name: storage
actions.why: Keep the addon list, its settings and the local resolve/stream cache

actions.name: notify
actions.why: Report addon test results and configuration problems

extensions.changelog: 1.0.6: Do not start a second addon stream on timeouts or 5xx. The query stream form is used only for 404/400/405, and a 503 preparing is retried on the same URL. 1.0.5: Two-level local cache with adjustable sizes/TTLs and a live simpler page. 1.0.4: Live playback page. 1.0.3: Prefetch. 1.0.2: Removed the status probe. 1.0.1: Stream expiry fixes. 1.0.0: First release.
